The approved repurchase capacity doubled, but actual purchases are discretionary and no funding amount was disclosed.
The existing end date is unchanged, so the expanded authorization does not extend the program.
This is a capital-allocation update, not evidence that shares have already been repurchased. Actual purchases, including their timing and number, would need to be disclosed to establish execution.
